content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to signing it, but I would like to propose a couple of adjustments first: - Regarding the relevant clause on work products, ownership currently transfers before payment is received; I propose that ownership of all deliverables and work products developed in the performance of services under the agreement shall transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment by the contractor. - Regarding the relevant clause on liability, certain claims are excluded from the limitation; I propose that each party's total liability in respect of damages under the agreement shall be limited to the amounts received from the client in terms of the agreement. Best regards,
